headline: Redeia changes bonus of its operations director after CNMC complains of conflict of interest
summary: Redeia's board changed the bonus of its operations director after the CNMC raised conflict-of-interest concerns. The board set specific objectives to reinforce the independence of the system operator.
why: Redeia is the Spanish grid operator and holding company for Red Eléctrica, and its independence is regulated by Spain's CNMC competition and energy regulator.
